name: wpewebkit

tag_signature.method: gpg --verify of the tag object's signature and payload (GitHub API git/tags), signer key fetched from keys.openpgp.org by fingerprint; GitHub also reports verification 'valid'
tag_signature.caveats: The key is not certified through any web of trust here, so this proves the tag was signed by that key, not independently who holds it. The key is DSA-1024 (created 2008, expires 2027-03-16); a release that outlives the expiry needs the key's renewal checked.

product_source.fetch: git fetch --depth=1 --filter=blob:none <repository> <commit>: trees only (about 14 MB); blobs of the checkout paths are fetched on demand
notes: The commit id and its tree id pin every byte of the tree (git hashes the commit, the directories and each file); ls_tree_sha256 and tree_entries additionally pin the recursive listing, so adding or dropping a file is also detected.

The WPE tarball stays the *reference* source (WPE baseline, JSCOnly, 3A). This source exists because the tarball has no Windows port (no PlatformWin.cmake, no Windows IPC backend) and PlatformCRT's Mac/Win reference reading needs the whole tree.
Nothing from this tree is patched in place. A PlatformCRT file is either a new CRT-owned file or a recorded patch (libcrtweb/patches/manifest.json) with its license class.

tarball_correspondence.reading: Every file of the release tarball is the tagged commit's blob, byte for byte, except 130 ANGLE files (Windows shader headers and one .bat) that have CRLF line endings in the tarball and LF in git (.gitattributes eol conversion); zero files differ in content. The tarball is a strict subset of the tree plus generated Documentation and NEWS. The 35,810 Source files only the commit has are the ports the tarball leaves out (Windows, Mac, iOS, ...), which is why PlatformCRT needs the commit.

license.summary: Mixed per-file licensing. License files in the archive: LGPL-2 and LGPL-2.1 texts (Source/WebCore/LICENSE-LGPL-2, LICENSE-LGPL-2.1, Source/JavaScriptCore/COPYING.LIB), an Apple BSD-style 2-clause notice (Source/WebCore/LICENSE-APPLE), and bundled third-party components each with their own license file. Per-file headers: see license-scan.json (Apple/WebKit BSD-2-Clause and BSD-3-Clause are the bulk of the code, LGPL-2+/2.1+ the rest of WebKit's own; bundled components keep their licenses).
license.scan_status: license files inventoried 2026-10-03 (64 files, license-inventory.json); per-file header scan of the whole Source tree of the pinned commit done 2026-10-10 (69,573 files, license-scan.json, tools/scan_webkit_headers.py); patch manifest checked by tools/check_webkit_patch_manifest.py

confirmed_from_primary_sources: wpewebkit.org/release lists 2.54.x as the current stable series, 2.54.0 released 2026-09-16, development series 2.53.92.

The 2.54.0 release page states: the WPEPlatform embedding API is stable and enabled by default; the legacy libwpe-based API remains but is deprecated; cairo rendering was removed and Skia is the only 2D renderer, with the compositor moved from TextureMapper to Skia in the web process; Ninja is mandatory; ENABLE_WPE_LEGACY_API=OFF disables the legacy API.

GitHub API: refs/tags/wpewebkit-2.54.0 is an annotated tag (object 1616e9ae260d8d0601da601de24cd8d96adc5e0f, tagger date 2026-09-16T09:54:47Z, PGP-signed) pointing at commit 73f39d84ea9d4071994214373efbde3665402b05.
HTTP HEAD of the archive URL: 200, Content-Length 46202080 bytes, Last-Modified 2026-09-16 10:01:39 GMT.

WSA-2026-0006 (2026-09-29) is the latest advisory listed and gives its affected versions as 'WebKitGTK and WPE WebKit before 2.54.0 or earlier' (upstream's wording), so this pin is not listed as affected; the advisory is a large batch dominated by bundled Skia/ANGLE issues. Its CVE list was not audited here.
The archive was downloaded and its SHA-256 recomputed locally: efa9bcc3cb891c2d88f50eec710d9ccee71cbdf1040420361eb98c17355eb452, size 46202080, identical to the release page (tools/fetch_webkit.py).
The tag's signature verifies with gpg (see source.tag_signature).

Six sampled source files (Source/cmake/OptionsWPE.cmake, Source/JavaScriptCore/COPYING.LIB, Source/WebCore/LICENSE-LGPL-2.1, Source/ThirdParty/skia/include/core/SkMilestone.h, Source/WTF/wtf/Platform.h, CMakeLists.txt) are byte-identical (git blob SHA-1) to the tree at the tagged commit; the top-level NEWS is a release-tarball file with no counterpart at that commit. The tarball is not otherwise proven to equal the commit tree.
The archive bundles its own Skia (milestone 154, Source/ThirdParty/skia/include/core/SkMilestone.h) and ANGLE; CRT's Skia is m148.

2026-10-10 (Tranche 3B): the whole tarball, not six samples, was compared with the tagged commit's tree by git blob id: 34,417 files identical, 130 identical after CRLF->LF, 0 content differences, 4,295 only in the archive (generated Documentation, NEWS); see product_source.tarball_correspondence.

2026-10-10 (Tranche 3B): per-file license headers of all 69,573 files under Source/ of the pinned commit were classified (libcrtweb/third_party/webkit/license-scan.json): the classifier recognises standard texts and SPDX tags and reports the rest as unclassified, never guessed.
not_yet_verified: Upstream's security support window for a stable series is not documented on the pages consulted.

import.status: pinned and verified (Web Tranche 0); nothing is fetched into a build, imported or compiled yet
import.fetch: tools/fetch_webkit.py (download and verify); tools/scan_webkit_licenses.py (license inventory); extraction arrives with Tranche 1
notes: The archive is a release tarball, not a git archive, so it carries no commit header: expected_commit is the authority for provenance and is recorded from the signed tag, while archive_sha256 pins the exact bytes CRT builds from.

WPE WebKit 2.54 is the reference for Tranche 2 and the structural model for PlatformCRT. It is not itself the product: the CRT port is a separate platform implementation (docs/porting/crtweb_porting.md).

Do not patch upstream source to hide a missing CRT/PAL surface (AGENTS.md porting loop). Any carried patch needs a row in docs/porting/crtweb_porting.md with its upstream reference and removal condition.

security_policy.rule: A pinned version is affected by an advisory when it is older than the advisory's fixed version. Re-check the pin against every new advisory; see docs/acceptance/crtweb_acceptance.md Tranche 0.

public_api_policy: No WebKit, WPE or GLib type, macro or header appears in any installed libcrtweb or crtui header.
tools/verify_dist.py (stage 06-web) will fail if a WebKit/WPE/GLib header leaks into the public SDK, as it already does for LVGL in 05-ui.
